entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md; confirmed API keys and ai_router import; verified AcmeCoffeeDbContext uses EnsureCreated (not EF migrations) and consulted human, who chose to keep the EnsureCreated + raw-SQL-DDL pattern.
Routed analysis to author ai-assignment.md (Gemini Pro recommendation; actual orchestrator is Claude Opus 4.7).
Added .IsTemporal() with named period (SysStart/SysEnd) and history tables (ProductHistory, CustomerHistory, OrderHistory, OrderItemHistory, OrderNoteHistory) to all five entity configurations.

Extended EnsureAcmeCoffeeSchemaAsync with EnableSystemVersioningAsync — idempotent ALTER TABLE DDL that adds HIDDEN period columns and turns on SYSTEM_VERSIONING for the 5 tables, guarded by temporal_type<>2 check.

Authored TemporalTablesTests.cs covering: system-versioning verdict, history-table presence, Product update creates history row (probe pattern), Product delete preserves row in history, Customer TemporalAsOf returns prior-time value, Order TemporalAll returns historical versions.

dotnet build clean. dotnet test full solution (non-Playwright): 864 pass, 5 pre-existing TemplateSeedSmokeTests failures unrelated to this session (confirmed via git stash baseline). All 38 Api.Tests pass including the 6 new temporal tests.

Cross-provider session verification via route(task_type='session-verification'). GPT-5.4 (OpenAI) verified Anthropic Opus orchestrator work. Verdict: VERIFIED, no issues. Saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Wrote disposition.json, change-log.md (routed summarization, gemini-flash, $0.0003), updated ai-assignment.md actuals, routed next-set recommendation (gemini-pro, $0.0049). Committed (a47043a) and pushed to migrate/dabbler-ai-router-pip.

Step 9 reorganization review: NO move candidates for project-guidance.md or lessons-learned.md (no Lesson→Convention promotions with ≥2-context evidence, no demotions, no relocations identified). Separately, per rule #14, added a new lesson to lessons-learned.md about test-time Customer rows racing the security-seed backfill under xUnit parallelism.
